title: Data Engineer
description:
An exciting marketing and media technology business in London is looking for a Data Engineer to join their growing data team.

  • Based in London
  • 4 days a week in the office (Monday to Thursday)
  • Permanent position
  • Start date: ASAP
  • £60,000 to £65,000 depending on experience

The Job

As the Data Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions
  • Working with BigQuery, SQL, Looker ML and modern data platforms to transform and activate data
  • Integrating data from CRM, marketing, analytics and third-party platforms
  • Advising stakeholders on data architecture, implementation and best practice
  • Collaborating with clients and internal teams to deliver data-driven solutions
  • Supporting reporting, analytics and data visualisation initiatives
  • Contributing to AI and marketing technology transformation projects
  • Managing data integration projects from inception through to delivery

You

  • Strong experience with GCP, BigQuery and SQL
  • Experience using Looker ML
  • Background in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering or Data Solutions
  • Experience working with marketing, media, martech or adtech data
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience delivering client-facing data solutions
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM or Marketing Cloud is highly desirable
  • Knowledge of Snowflake would be beneficial
  • Comfortable translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Agency or publisher-side experience would be advantageous

Apply Now

You can apply for the Data Engineer position now by sending us your CV or by calling us now! Don't forget to register as a candidate too.

Amy Brown
Associate Director
